question: For $$A=\begin{bmatrix}1&2\\-1&3\end{bmatrix},\quad B=\begin{bmatrix}2&0\\1&4\end{bmatrix},\quad C=\begin{bmatrix}3&-1\\2&1\end{bmatrix},$$ evaluate $A(B+C)$ and $AB+AC$ separately and thereby verify the distributive property of matrix multiplication over matrix addition for these matrices.
explanation:
Evaluation of $A(B+C)$

First, $$B+C=\begin{bmatrix}2&0\\1&4\end{bmatrix}+\begin{bmatrix}3&-1\\2&1\end{bmatrix}=\begin{bmatrix}5&-1\\3&5\end{bmatrix}$$ Hence, $$A(B+C)=\begin{bmatrix}1&2\\-1&3\end{bmatrix}\begin{bmatrix}5&-1\\3&5\end{bmatrix}$$ $$=\begin{bmatrix}1(5)+2(3)&1(-1)+2(5)\\(-1)(5)+3(3)&(-1)(-1)+3(5)\end{bmatrix}=\begin{bmatrix}11&9\\4&16\end{bmatrix}$$

Evaluation of $AB+AC$

We have $$AB=\begin{bmatrix}1&2\\-1&3\end{bmatrix}\begin{bmatrix}2&0\\1&4\end{bmatrix}=\begin{bmatrix}4&8\\1&12\end{bmatrix}$$ Also, $$AC=\begin{bmatrix}1&2\\-1&3\end{bmatrix}\begin{bmatrix}3&-1\\2&1\end{bmatrix}=\begin{bmatrix}7&1\\3&4\end{bmatrix}$$ Therefore, $$AB+AC=\begin{bmatrix}4&8\\1&12\end{bmatrix}+\begin{bmatrix}7&1\\3&4\end{bmatrix}=\begin{bmatrix}11&9\\4&16\end{bmatrix}$$ Thus, $$A(B+C)=AB+AC$$ and the distributive property is verified for the given matrices.
